entry_points.text: Per-CPU teardown runs TDX before VMX when enabled; hardware setup runs VMX then TDX on success; CPU caps advertise virt, protection, tracing, debug, perf, SGX, interrupts and timing per hardware and nesting with CET needing triple presence; timer scales host frequency, derives max from hypervisor and calibration and disables when too frequent to avoid spurious exits or when unsupported with no-op fallback; user-return registers fixed MSR list matching capacity.

VMX init disables pause exits without gap, warns on L1TF exposure with threading or missing flush and sizes dirty logging; teardown dispatches TDX key release and page reclaim versus VMX destroy; key release flushes each vCPU, completes bookkeeping, writes back caches and frees ID under hotplug lock and mutex, leaking ID on unexpected error and exiting early when not done.

Precreate idempotently ensures zeroed posted table only with in-kernel chip and posted enabled; create dispatches TDX versus VMX; VMX create acquires VPID, single-page PML and conversion buffers, all-ones return masks, cleared VMCS and on-demand APIC, identity and posted resources unwinding on failure; identity installs one private one-to-one huge mapping once under slot mutex.

Free dispatches TDX flush with early return while associated else reclaim versus VMX release of logging, IDs, nested, VMCS, conversion and posted with zeroed table entry; reset dispatches with TDX warning on INIT and deferring model to userspace.

exports.text: Nested setup prepares tables, views, shadow state and exit handlers, disabling shadowing when unsupported with full cleanup; teardown clears posted wakeup, frees nested shadow only if nesting enabled and releases TDX cgroup capacity if TDX enabled.

Per-CPU teardown flushes TDX guests and clears VMCS state under disabled interrupts with safe walks; nested controls build MSR views and publish enum; VMCS12 lookup validates, hardens index and treats zero as absent in sparse table while install gates on CPU caps with timer and log emulated; SGX hash uses defaults or snapshots hardware or no-ops; VM init dispatches TDX versus VMX; VMX destroy frees posted table sized by vCPU IDs; PML free is idempotent.

hazards.text: Module error helpers record operation name with status words for diagnostics; teardown treats unexpected errors as fatal while ignoring busy by ordering.

invariants.text: EVMCS reads reuse versioned reader with caller offset and width from encoding; low-bit means narrow half; index derives by mask and shift with table position a rotation and enum the max present; 64-bit halves gate jointly with unknown widths warning and all-ones; EPT depth is five only if supported; perf builds from PMU excluding adaptive to avoid defects, disclosure and bypass; encryption mask reserves KeyID gap.

Nested pin, exit, entry, primary, secondary, misc, basic and fixed views intersect host config with narrow allowlists plus mandatory bits, emulating shadowing and masking EPT, VPID and APIC per toggles; container holds control pairs plus misc, basic, fixed, EPT, VPID, VMFUNC and enum; VMXON fixes CR0 protection, paging and numeric-error and CR4 VMX; shadow starts deny-all then enables versioned fields, validating halves and skipping PML and timer without backing.

TDX attrs and XFAM intersect desires with module fixed constraints failing closed; key assigned only when positive with minus one unassigned and free dropping cgroup charge; flush skips when unassociated with minus one meaning none; container helpers derive TDX VM and vCPU from embedded members.

VPID zero means disabled with alloc and free under spinlock; APIC access needs flexpriority and in-kernel APIC while posted needs in-kernel plus enable; EVMCS reset is inert when inactive else validates assist page warning once and aborting if missing; local cleanup clears all images tolerating migration; hardware clear uses physical address.

Cross-unit helpers set host and masks; segments start flat with full limits and present writable attrs, reset to F000 with base FFFF0000 and cleared tables retaining types; FB-disable needs host control without auto clearing and no guest immunity; baseline pin, primary, secondary, tertiary, entry and exit controls mask globals by hardware, enables and guest exposure with windows dynamic, save and load forced off, no shadow during baseline and shared timestamp handling; host captures regs, kernel selectors with cleared data on 64-bit, task selector, tables and resume with FS and GS cleared warning on task-switched flag and sampling paging non-atomically with zeroed perf when mediated; guest-owned CR bits derive from allowed minus reserved and EPT and nested adjustments.

Cross-unit helpers shadow hash and set ENCLS policy; bitmap is all-ones intercepting all when SGX unavailable or guest disabled with forced clearing despite base; firmware enable needs enable plus lock; creation gating checks provisioning and host matching; SGX2 releases aug and mod while init stays intercepted with nested merges; per-vCPU launch hash shadows host with no-op fallback and launch control never switched.

locks.text: Disassociation needs interrupts disabled and orders list removal before publishing invalid CPU with barrier to block re-add.

state_machines.text: Provides one-time TDX and VMX setup; TDX always inits tracking then enables with larger state and handlers or gracefully disables when module absent or prereqs fail, validating regs, metadata, attrs, topology, CPU limits and keys; VMX captures host and keeps each accel only with hardware prereq, failing on missing execute-disable or illegal profiling while degrading unsupported profiling.

Loaded images check owner, clear current and list then publish invalid and unlaunched in order; TDX flush under disabled interrupts with safe walk verifies CPU still owns, skips hardware for never-init while updating tracking and records failures except benign without console in IPI context; TD starts uninit, must init before vCPU create and returns after destroy with vCPUs likewise; VM init marks protected state, opts out PAT, clears MMIO for guest fault delivery and clamps vCPUs to present CPUs; vCPU create rejects uninit or non-split IRQ then sets confidential, APIC, time and posted state; free flushes while associated else reclaims.

Cross-unit reset helper; nested free brings online, exits guest mode clearing pending, resets VMXON, frees ID, tears down shadow, cached structures, pages, roots and enlightened state with minus one invalid posted target and invalid GPA; disabling shadow clears control, link and sync; reset optionally rebuilds baseline then clears tracking, rebuilds segments and tables, marks caches, clears activity to active with no blocking, deadline minus one and tracing mask, reloads APIC, syncs IDs and refreshes mitigations; posted uses architected vectors with suppress and invalid nested pointers; MSR areas start empty with invalid link, zero counts, masks, sysentry and debug plus microcode and feature defaults.

structs.text: Pin allowlist adds NMI and interrupt masking to always-on; primary covers halt, CR, IO, debug, time, monitor, paging, perf, windows, priority, bitmaps, trap, pause and secondary activation; secondary permits APICv, cache, IDs, paging, unrestricted, descriptors, time, state, random, scaling, wait, tracing, bus-lock, notify, mode-based and enclave; tertiary and VMFUNC advertise none; exit and entry add debug, interrupt, address, perf, power, boundary and tracing handling; descriptor pairs offset with clean slot.

Loaded VMCS bundles control and optional shadow pages with owning CPU, launch flag, deny bitmap, host state and shadowed controls; alloc zeroes, stamps revision and marks shadow with minus one meaning unowned; shadowing bitmap helper is cross-unit.

Reclaim skips while key assigned else reclaims array pages then root with cache flush, quirk reset and free; any failure leaks the page and root failure aborts; unexpected module errors are fatal while busy is ignored by ordering.
